name: l0_scheme_file_load
about: The KeyValues FILE loader FUN_102480f0 (0x102480f0) -- the call CSoundScheme::Precache (0x1022a4b0) makes through FUN_1022a930 on a node named SoundScheme (0x105a63f4) for sound/Schemes/SP_Tutorial_City.txt with pathID 0 and cache 1 -- with its token wrapper FUN_102482b0 (0x102482b0, buffer 0x10754fa8), its block parser FUN_10248510 (0x10248510) and the whole-file text cache FUN_102482f0 (0x102482f0). Cache set and `.txt` in the name (strstr, 0x10546e4c): the cache is asked first; its CRC-32 of the name (0x1023f040/0c0/060, table 0x10496f58) misses -> it opens the file itself (`rb` 0x105596cc, pathID 0), interns the text (1 MiB arena 0x105c530c) and returns it; a hit returns the interned text whatever the file now holds; a NULL (open failed, arena full, no `.txt`, cache 0) sends the loader to its own Open/Size/Read/Close, and only a failed open there returns 0. Then every top-level token is a root: the first renames the caller's node (0x10247cf0: children, value and chain dropped), each next is a new node linked after the previous (+0x10); the token after a root opens a block when its FIRST byte is `{` (CMP byte [EAX],0x7B; a quoted "{abc" qualifies) and is dropped otherwise. In a block (0x10248510): an empty key (EOF or quoted "") or `}` (0x10547b64) returns; the child is created (0x10248870) before its value is read; `{` (0x10547b78, 2-byte compare) recurses; a quoted value is type 0; an unquoted one is typed by _strtol (0x104319a8, base 10, saturating) against _strtod (0x1043190e, decimal-only, `d`/`e` exponents): strtod consuming more -> type 2 float, strtol consuming anything -> type 1 int, else type 0. `}` in value position is a value; a key at EOF is a "" string leaf. Returns 1 for empty text (zero roots, the node unrenamed). Reported as `fail` when a cache arm, a root arm, a leaf type or value or the return differs from retail's.
